function.description: Retrieves the details of a specific network device configuration file using the `id`.
function.name: api_getConfigurationFileDetailsByID

id.description: The value of `id` can be obtained from the response of API `/dna/intent/api/v1/networkDeviceConfigFiles`

createdBy.description: The entity responsible for creating the configuration changes.

createdTime.description: The UNIX epoch timestamp in milliseconds marking when the resource was created.

fileType.description: Type of configuration file. Config File Type can be 'RUNNINGCONFIG' or 'STARTUPCONFIG' or 'VLAN'.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the configuration file.

networkDeviceId.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the network devices.

versionId.description: The version unique identifier triggered after any config change.
